_comment: Per-venue WiFi adapter bindings. Each entry maps an anchor `id` (defined in the placement-editor blueprint at positioning-demo/public/layout.json) to its physical BSSIDs. Positions are NOT here - they come from the blueprint. BSSIDs below are placeholders; for a real venue, copy this file to dev/wifi-config.local.json (gitignored) with the real values and `export WIFI_CONFIG=./dev/wifi-config.local.json` before `make demo`.
